# Parse the old songs list and get all song IDs from playlists
old_songs_content = old_songs_file['content']
old_songs = set()
for line in old_songs_content.splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
        if ' by ' in line:
            title, artists_str = line.split(' by ', 1)
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            old_songs.add((title.strip(), frozenset(artists)))
